name: task_update
description: Update fields on an existing task card. Only the fields you pass will change. Pass `trigger_script` / `end_script` to overwrite the bash snippets on disk.

name.description: Name of the task card to update.

check_interval.description: New cadence in seconds for polling trigger_script / end_script (must be > 0).

trigger_script.description: New bash body for core/tasks/<name>.trigger.sh. Last line must be `[start]`, `[start] <message>`, or `[skip]`.

end_script.description: New bash body for core/tasks/<name>.end.sh (last line `[done]`/`[not_done]`). Pass null / empty string to delete the end script.
